mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hash_ref_num WHERE hash = #{hash} for update
mapper.update: update hash_ref_num set ref_num = ref_num + 1 where hash = #{hash} and ref_num > 0
update hash_ref_num set ref_num = ref_num - 1 where hash = #{hash} and ref_num > 0
mapper.insert: insert into hash_ref_num(hash, ref_path, ref_num) VALUES (#{hash}, #{ref_path}, #{ref_num})
